Hero.comment: Fourth-year undergraduate in an information systems department. I research anomaly detection and build and operate my own autonomous-agent infrastructure.

Profile.title: PROFILE
Profile.description:
I enrolled in April 2023 and am now a fourth-year student, planning to continue to a master's program (class of 2029).
My interests are ML Platform, DevSecOps, and SRE: building the systems that keep ML running for the long term, safely and reproducibly.
My research focuses on anomaly detection (network intrusion detection), and at home I build and operate my own autonomous-agent infrastructure and homelab.

1.title: NIDS Survey (lead author)
1.description: Leading a survey on network-based intrusion detection, focusing on data preprocessing, data partitioning, and feature extraction, with an empirical assessment of how evaluation conditions differ across studies.

2.title: Graduation research: evaluation framework for NIDS
2.description: Developing a common experimental framework for comparative evaluation of network intrusion detection methods — shared specifications for input formatting, data partitioning, metrics, and compute budget.

3.title: HAR: class-wise analysis of CGAN-based missing-modality imputation
3.description: Analyzed how a CGAN behaves, class by class, when imputing missing modalities in human activity recognition (HAR).

NEXUS.title: NEXUS / Agent-core
NEXUS.description: An autonomous multi-agent platform running on my home k3s cluster. Role-specialized agents act as a secretary and development assistant, with Discord as the interface.

Homelab.title: Homelab Infrastructure
Homelab.description: A two-node k3s cluster on Proxmox, with Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, GitOps-based configuration management, and Cloudflare Tunnel for exposure.

Future.title: FUTURE
Future.vision: Delivering trustworthy AI behind the scenes of society

1.title: Explainability
1.description: High accuracy alone does not make an AI that people can use with confidence. Why did it reach that decision, and how far can it be trusted? I value being able to explain the behavior of AI.

2.title: Robust Architecture
2.description: The less visible a system is, the less it can afford to stop. Rather than temporary accuracy or trends, I value designs built to keep running for the long term.

3.title: Full Stack Perspective
3.description: Building a model is not the goal. Where is that AI used, who does it reach, and how is it operated? Taking backend and infrastructure into view as well, I aim for AI that works in society.

Future.closing: I aim to become an engineer who can design and operate the foundations that keep models built in research running in society for the long term.
